bpWarnings.note: SimpleListDetails scaffold still writes Caption=General as raw text - unchanged from the 278eee3 run

root_cause_hypothesis: FIX VERIFIED - the primary defect of run 2026-08-31T22 (278eee3) is CLOSED. ONE d365fo_file(action="create", objectType="enum") call with enumValues in ladder order, no useEnumValue and no isExtensible, now writes <Value>1</Value>/<Value>2</Value>/<Value>3</Value> (0 omitted) alongside <UseEnumValue>No</UseEnumValue>, byte-identical to the golden. No modify-enum-value repair step was needed. The runtime oracle confirms it: EvalL3ServiceTierDowngradeTest 3/3 PASS, including testDowngradeIsRejected, which is exactly the assertion that failed while every member was 0. get_knowledge(kind="op-spec", topic="enum") now states the correct rule ("every member keeps its number ... A member WITHOUT <Value> is 0, not the next ordinal") plus the isExtensible/non-equality-comparison consequence, so the knowledge and the writer agree. DEFECT 2 of the old record (modify-property FormRef written verbatim without resolving to a menu item display) was not re-triggered: the display menu item was created first and the property took it - the validation gap itself was not negative-tested this run, so treat it as unverified rather than fixed. THREE defects remain open, all in the form path. (A) generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="form", formPattern="SimpleListDetails") writes EXPLICIT child controls (Overview_ChangeLogId, Overview_ServiceTier) inside a group whose binding is <DataGroup>Overview</DataGroup>. The server's own add-control op-spec declares that shape illegal ("A BASE-FORM parent bound to a table field group via <DataGroup> is REFUSED: the compiler generates that group's members, so an explicit control collides") - the scaffold does the very thing add-control refuses. The golden has <Controls /> for that group. (B) The same scaffold auto-generates ComboBox controls for the enum field in BOTH the grid (Grid_ServiceTier) and the details tab (Tab_ServiceTier), so the case requirement "expose the enum field EXCLUSIVELY via add-control" is unreachable: four remove-control calls were needed before the ComboBox could be added and the golden shape reached. Related: params.generateControls has NO observable effect - scaffolding with generateControls:true and with it omitted produced byte-identical XML (16 controls both times), while the response line reported "Controls: 1" and "Controls: 0" respectively, neither of which is the number written. (C) get_object_info(objectType="form") still hides the children of a DataGroup-bound group: it listed Overview with no children and "Controls: 14" while the XML on disk held 16 - the exact defect recorded at 278eee3, unchanged, and the case instruction routes the agent through that call to read the details group name. (D) Unchanged: the scaffold writes <Caption>General</Caption> as raw text on TabPageGeneral (BPErrorLabelIsText). bp_clean stays 0 with the identical 5-warning set as the previous run; 0 BP ERRORS, so the case's own BP bar (zero errors, explicit per-object targets) is met.
suggested_fix_area: generateObject form scaffold (SimpleListDetails): (1) never emit explicit child controls under a group carrying <DataGroup> - the field group generates them; (2) do not auto-bind every table field into grid + details tab, or make that opt-in via generateControls, which currently does nothing; (3) TabPage Caption must be a label id, not raw text; (4) the "Controls: N" line in the scaffold response does not count what was written. tools/objectInfo form reader: list children of a DataGroup-bound group (Controls total is short by the hidden children). tools/fileOperations modify-property on table: still no menu-item-display resolution behind FormRef (unverified this run - needs a negative test).
